item.title: Kaoru Mitoma ruled out for six weeks with ankle ligament damage
item.description: Brighton's head coach has confirmed the Japan winger will miss the next six weeks, after scans revealed ligament damage in his right ankle which was sustained against Everton on Saturday.

item.title: Ito targeted by Premier League clubs after impressive season
item.description: Two top-flight sides are weighing an approach for the Japan international this summer, according to sources, with a bid expected before the window shuts.
